smokeTestNotes: Docs and pricing pages checked. No account, payment, or hands-on run.
name: Google Gemini
shortDescription: General-purpose assistant from Google, with a free plan and paid Google AI plans.
longDescription: Gemini is Google's general assistant. The Google One AI plans page, read October 16, 2026, lists a free Gemini plan, Google AI Plus at $4.99 per month, and Google AI Pro at $19.99 per month in the United States. We did not subscribe. It is not a specialist for one job.
pricingNotes: Google AI Plus is $4.99 per month and Google AI Pro is $19.99 per month on the US Google One plans page. A free plan exists.
bestFor: Researching, comparing, and drafting inside Google's apps
notIdealFor: A job that needs parcel records, a brokerage link, or a video timeline
strength: Google lists a free Gemini plan, and Google AI Plus starts at $4.99 per month in the United States.
weakness: It is a general assistant, not a specialist for parcels, portfolios, or video clipping.
